title: Dataset of Speech Production in intracranial Electroencephalography (SingleWordProductionDutch-iBIDS)
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 10 Dutch-speaking patients with pharmaco-resistant epilepsy who read aloud 100 Dutch words presented one at a time on a laptop screen. Intracranial EEG (1103 recorded contacts spanning cortical and subcortical structures) was recorded simultaneously with the participants' pitch-shifted speech audio. The dataset supports research on speech production and speech decoding for brain-computer interfaces, and includes electrode localisations and FreeSurfer derivatives.
methods_description: Dixi Medical Microdeep sEEG shafts were recorded with Micromed SD LTM amplifiers at 1024 or 2048 Hz (downsampled to 1024 Hz). Audio was captured with a notebook microphone at 48 kHz and synchronised with neural and stimulus streams via LabStreamingLayer. Each word was shown for 2 s followed by a 1 s fixation cross. Electrodes were localised with img_pipe by co-registering pre-implant T1 MRI with post-implant CT, and labelled with the Destrieux atlas.
